name: DiffCompareCard
job: Compare two options on a physical balance: each differing row is a weight on the side that wins it, and the beam tilts toward the overall winner for the priorities the visitor picks
visitor_action: toggle 'What matters to you' chips (counts, counts double, off) and watch the beam re-tilt and the verdict update; tap 'Same in both' to expand matching rows
owner_settings: Rows (label, first value, second value, optional numbers, unit, and better: higher or lower)
mobile: chips wrap above the verdict and beam; the two pans stay side by side and stack their weights; long text wraps, no horizontal scroll
motion: beam swings on a spring (slight overshoot) toward the weighted winner; digits roll like an odometer on arrival; weights collapse in and out as chips toggle (reduced-motion: beam snaps, digits and weights swap instantly)
art_direction: Balance: white sheet, ink beam with pivot and soft shadow, cobalt-tinted pan for option A vs ink-topped pan for B, IBM Plex Sans, odometer digits
